flowchart.title: Top to bottom
flowchart.desc: Default vertical layout with TD direction

graph TD

    B -->|Yes| C[Process]
    B -->|No| D[End]
    C --> D

graph LR
    A[Start] --> B{Decision}
    B -->|Yes| C[Process]
    B -->|No| D[End]
    C --> D

flowchart.title: Subgraph pipeline
flowchart.desc: Chained subgraph-to-subgraph edges keep stages stacked in order

sequence.title: Arrow types
sequence.source:
sequenceDiagram
    A->>B: Solid arrow
    B-->>A: Dashed arrow
    A-xB: Solid cross
    B--xA: Dashed cross

sequence.title: Notes
sequence.desc: Notes placed to the right of or over participants
sequence.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Alice
    participant B as Bob
    A->>B: Hello
    Note right of B: Thinking...
    B-->>A: Hi there!
    Note over A,B: Conversation started

sequence.title: Alt and loop frames
sequence.desc: Conditional branches and repeated blocks drawn as scope frames
sequence.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant A as App
    participant S as Server
    U->>A: Login
    A->>S: POST /auth
    alt valid credentials
        S-->>A: 200 token
        A-->>U: Welcome
    else invalid
        S-->>A: 401
        A-->>U: Try again
    end
    loop every 5 min
        A->>S: refresh token
        S-->>A: new token
    end

sequence.title: OAuth 2.0 flow
sequence.desc: Authorization code grant with token exchange
sequence.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant C as Client
    participant A as Auth Server
    participant R as Resource
    U->>C: Login
    C->>A: Authorization Request
    A->>U: Login Prompt
    U->>A: Credentials
    A-->>C: Auth Code
    C->>A: Exchange Code
    A-->>C: Access Token
    C->>R: Request + Token
    R-->>C: Protected Data
    C-->>U: Dashboard

state.title: Basic
state.desc: State machine with transitions and labels
state.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Processing : submit
    Processing --> Done : success
    Processing --> Error : failure
    Error --> Idle : retry
    Done --> [*]

state.title: HTTP connection lifecycle
state.desc: Connection states from open to close
state.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Closed
    Closed --> Connecting : connect()
    Connecting --> Open : connected
    Connecting --> Closed : timeout
    Open --> Closing : close()
    Open --> Open : send/receive
    Closing --> Closed : done
    Closed --> [*]

state.title: Composite state
state.desc: Nested states inside a parent state with outer transitions
state.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Off
    Off --> On : power
    state On {
        [*] --> Idle
        Idle --> Playing : play
        Playing --> Paused : pause
        Paused --> Playing : play
    }
    On --> Off : power

state.title: Choice, fork and join
state.desc: Pseudo-states for branching and parallel paths
state.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    state check <<choice>>
    state fork_state <<fork>>
    state join_state <<join>>
    [*] --> Validate
    Validate --> check
    check --> Rejected : invalid
    check --> fork_state : valid
    fork_state --> Index
    fork_state --> Notify
    Index --> join_state
    Notify --> join_state
    join_state --> [*]
    Rejected --> [*]
